To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the educators’ use of ICT for teaching is affected by their personal, social, environmental and organisational factors.
the use of ICT in education depends on the educators’ personal, social, and environmental factors.
the educators in the Khanya project are not using ICT in their work due to a number of factors which are related to personal, social and environmental factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the capabilities of educators to use the technology in the curriculum.
the capability of educators in the Khanya schools to realise their potential from the use of ICT.
the question of why the educators are not using ICT in teaching and learning, and what can be done about it.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the educators in Khanya project are unable to use ICT for teaching because they lack the capability to use it.
the educators’ situation in Khanya schools is one of capability deprivation.
the educators’ capability to use the technology for teaching is being constrained by their own personal characteristics and their perceptions about the technology.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the educators are unable to use ICT for teaching because they are deprived of capabilities.
the educators are not using the ICT because they lack the skills and the confidence to do so, and because the ICT is not being integrated into their daily work.
the use of ICT for teaching and the learning of teachers and their students is a complex phenomenon and that the use of a single factor to explain the phenomenon is insufficient.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the educators need to be supported in the realisation of their potential capabilities from ICT.
the Khanya project should focus on building educators’ ICT capabilities in the schools.
the Khanya project needs to take a holistic view of the educators’ situation in order to realise the project’s vision of improving the quality of education through ICT.
